text: Round two of the clone test, run 20261116-4 made at 3896e64, collection collect-1 in the log folder (session 4e049de2, claude-fable-5-2 at high; files on this computer, not a record). What it changed in your paths exists only in that clone and goes with the run; the difference is in the collection as items/repo/changes.patch, and its commits are named in collection.json. Asked of you, each read by you in that patch and landed in your own words, not copied unread: (1) the Designer passed neither parameter_rows nor safety_rows of an intake to the A4 and A5 axes (its commit 786568e, with a test on the echo fixture); (2) every validation report said its environment was mock; it made that sandbox when a tool's contract declares an external program (79cb8c2); (3) its template v7, whose task validator judges a scientific task against the values a source states and says not_run where the gate refused the call (bfd910c); take what holds for instruments and engines in general and leave what is of that request; (4) src/build/bundle.py prints a field as (number, 1, required; ...): B6 now passes that form, so nothing is needed there unless you prefer another; (5) a template is materialised by the Designer at the build and not by hand: its session left an untracked template folder it could not remove. Landed by this seat from the same collection (e67e89d): check 3 takes a numeral of a locus as the card's; an intake's gap_reason is the tool profile's enum, so your stage can refuse another word; meta_agent/CLAUDE.md says when an engine may be started to try an adapter; build-library-skill says how a relation a source gives without a value gets its worked case; specify-and-build says to rehearse the Designer in a scratch root first. Not yours and not this seat's: what B9 asks of a tool that starts an engine under a confirmed execution permission, the safety rows, the package source, and the reference of the exact tolerance are put to the person. The run stands until the person says whether the request is carried into this repository. Reply by note with the commits.
